hostname rt-p01
!
crypto isakmp policy 10
 encryption aes 256
 hash sha256
 authentication pre-share
 group 14
 lifetime 28800
crypto isakmp policy 20
 encryption aes
 hash sha
 authentication pre-share
 group 2
crypto isakmp key dummy-psk-sample-c address 203.0.113.40
crypto isakmp key dummy-psk-sample-a address 203.0.113.20
!
crypto ikev2 proposal IKEV2-PROP
 encryption aes-cbc-256 aes-cbc-128
 integrity sha256 sha1
 group 14 5
!
crypto ikev2 policy IKEV2-POL
 proposal IKEV2-PROP
!
crypto ikev2 keyring IKEV2-KEYS
 peer Tunnel1
  address 203.0.113.30
  pre-shared-key dummy-psk-sample-b
!
crypto ikev2 profile IKEV2-Tunnel1
 match identity remote address 203.0.113.30 255.255.255.255
 authentication remote pre-share
 authentication local pre-share
 keyring local IKEV2-KEYS
 lifetime 86400
!
crypto ipsec transform-set TS-Tunnel1 esp-aes 256 esp-sha-hmac
 mode tunnel
!
crypto ipsec transform-set TS-Tunnel1-2 esp-aes esp-sha-hmac
!
crypto ipsec transform-set TS-Tunnel2 esp-aes 256 esp-sha-hmac
 mode tunnel
!
crypto ipsec transform-set TS-CMAP-GigabitEthernet0-0-10 esp-aes 256 esp-sha-hmac
 mode tunnel
!
crypto ipsec transform-set TS-CMAP-GigabitEthernet0-0-10-2 esp-aes esp-sha-hmac
!
ip access-list extended ACL-Tunnel1
 10 permit ip 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.127 198.51.100.128 0.0.0.127
!
crypto ipsec profile PROF-Tunnel1
 set transform-set TS-Tunnel1 TS-Tunnel1-2
 set security-association lifetime seconds 28800
 set ikev2-profile IKEV2-Tunnel1
!
ip access-list extended ACL-Tunnel2
 10 permit ip 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.127 203.0.113.128 0.0.0.127
!
crypto ipsec profile PROF-Tunnel2
 set transform-set TS-Tunnel2
 set security-association lifetime seconds 3600
!
ip access-list extended ACL-CMAP-GigabitEthernet0-0-10
 10 permit ip 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.127 198.51.100.0 0.0.0.127
 20 permit ip 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.127 host 198.51.100.200
!
crypto map CMAP-GigabitEthernet0-0 10 ipsec-isakmp
 set peer 203.0.113.20
 set transform-set TS-CMAP-GigabitEthernet0-0-10 TS-CMAP-GigabitEthernet0-0-10-2
 set pfs group14
 set security-association lifetime seconds 3600
 match address ACL-CMAP-GigabitEthernet0-0-10
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description sample-wan
 ip address 203.0.113.9 255.255.255.248
 crypto map CMAP-GigabitEthernet0-0
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description sample-lan
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.128
 no shutdown
!
interface Tunnel1
 ip unnumbered GigabitEthernet0/1
 tunnel source GigabitEthernet0/0
 tunnel destination 203.0.113.30
 tunnel mode ipsec ipv4
 tunnel protection ipsec policy ipv4 ACL-Tunnel1
 tunnel protection ipsec profile PROF-Tunnel1
 no shutdown
!
interface Tunnel2
 ip unnumbered GigabitEthernet0/1
 tunnel source GigabitEthernet0/0
 tunnel destination 203.0.113.40
 tunnel mode ipsec ipv4
 tunnel protection ipsec policy ipv4 ACL-Tunnel2
 tunnel protection ipsec profile PROF-Tunnel2
 no shutdown
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 203.0.113.14 1
ip route 198.51.100.128 255.255.255.128 Tunnel1 1
ip route 203.0.113.128 255.255.255.128 Tunnel2 1
!
end
